name: go_ahead
title: Section C · "go ahead" in words answers the one yes card open; with two, Alpha asks which

steps.say: Start a helper in the background, as a piece of work beside us, that uses a short Python script (not WebFetch) to read https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1 and tell me its title. Don't run the script yourself; carry on talking with me meanwhile.
steps.reply:
A helper has started in the background. It will write a short Python script that reads that address and tells me the title, and I'll pass it on when it reports back.

That site isn't on the list of addresses your scripts can reach yet, so a card may come up asking you to allow it. The helper can't read the page until you say yes there.

We can keep talking in the meantime. What would you like to do next?

steps.reply: Done. I've allowed your scripts to read from jsonplaceholder.typicode.com, and the helper is running again. I'll tell you the title once it reports back.

steps.say: Start two helpers in the background at once, as two pieces of work beside us: one uses a short Python script (not WebFetch) to read https://httpbin.org/json and tell me its slideshow title, the other uses a short Python script (not WebFetch) to read https://api.github.com/zen and tell me what it says. Don't run the scripts yourself.
steps.reply:
Both helpers are now running in the background. One is reading the slideshow title from httpbin.org, and the other is reading GitHub's zen line.

Neither site is on your allowed list yet, so you'll probably get two cards asking whether to let your scripts reach them. Neither helper can read its page until you say yes to its card. I'll tell you what each one finds once it reports back.

steps.reply: Two sites are waiting for your yes, httpbin.org and api.github.com, and "go ahead" doesn't say which one you mean. Should I allow both, or only one? Pick on the card or tell me here, and the helpers will carry on as soon as you answer.

checks.why: 1 answered in words: Yes, always ("go ahead").
